fragen.frage: Why do you delete the .conf from Downloads after importing?
antworten: It contains your private key – in Downloads any program can read it
It takes up too much space
fragen.erklaerung: Bony's VPN stored it safely (/etc/wireguard, root only). The copy in Downloads is unnecessary – and a risk.

fragen.frage: The tunnel drops, the kill switch is on. What happens?
antworten: The Agent PC carries on browsing without the tunnel
Nothing gets to the internet any more until the tunnel is up again
The Agent PC turns itself off
fragen.erklaerung: That's exactly what the kill switch is for: no tunnel, no internet – so your real address never becomes visible.

fragen.frage: Where is your key after importing?
antworten: On the desktop so you can find it
Safely in /etc/wireguard, only readable by root – Bony's VPN never shows it
fragen.erklaerung: Bony's VPN's helper stores the configuration with permissions 600. The key never appears in displays or output.
